definitions.explanation: The practice of predicting the future or reading a person's fate through various methods such as astrology, palm reading, tarot cards, etc. Also refers to the result of such a reading.

examples.japanese: {占|うらな}い⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{信|しん}じます→信じる：01111_shinjiru⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧。
⟦{今朝|けさ}→今朝：02877_kesa⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦テレビ→テレビ：01536_terebi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{占|うらな}い⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{一位|いちい}→一位：08926_ichii⟧だった。
examples.english: I was ranked first in this morning's TV horoscope.

examples.japanese: ⟦{友達|ともだち}→友達：01478_tomodachi⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{原宿|はらじゅく}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{占|うらな}い⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦もらった→もらう：00520_morau⟧。
examples.english: My friend and I had our fortunes told in Harajuku.

notes:
{占|うらな}い is derived from the verb ⟦{占|うらな}う→占う：01905_uranau⟧ (to tell fortunes). It covers all forms of fortune-telling and divination.

TYPES OF {占|うらな}い:
- ⟦{星占|ほしうらな}い→星占い：18861_hoshiuranai⟧: astrology, horoscope
- ⟦{手相|てそう}→手相：27787_tesou⟧{占|うらな}い: palm reading
- タロット{占|うらな}い: tarot reading
- ⟦{血液型|けつえきがた}→血液型：03053_ketsuekigata⟧{占|うらな}い: blood type fortune-telling (popular in Japan)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {占|うらな}い{師|し}: fortune-teller
- {占|うらな}い⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦もらう→もらう：00520_morau⟧: to have one's fortune told
- {占|うらな}い⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{信|しん}じる→信じる：01111_shinjiru⟧: to believe in fortune-telling
- ⟦{今日|きょう}→今日：00496_kyou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{占|うらな}い: today's horoscope

CULTURAL NOTE:
Morning TV shows in Japan commonly feature daily horoscope segments. ⟦{血液型|けつえきがた}→血液型：03053_ketsuekigata⟧{占|うらな}い (blood type personality reading) is a uniquely popular form of fortune-telling in Japan.
